modes.on-demand: Container starts only for claimed work and stops when it drains (durable_object scheduling policy or an equivalent owned wake path).
modes.managed: Instance-level sleep configured (sleepAfter); the Cloudflare application object stays deployed and is woken by its Worker/Durable Object.
modes.retire-under-#1954: Retained per-release residue that no current serving route requires; retirement is executed only by the release owner under #1954.
modes.always-on-tracked: Known always-on compute with an owning follow-up issue; must not expand beyond the tracked declarations.
modes.event-infra: Workers, Durable Objects, Queues, R2 and Neon: managed event or persistence services, exempt from container residency rules.

contract.rule: Every containers[] declaration in cloudflare/* and packages/* wrangler.jsonc files, and every generated declaration listed here, must map to a declarations[] entry. A declaration with no durable_object scheduling_policy and no verifiable sleepAfter evidence fails unless it is recorded as always-on-tracked or retire-under-#1954 with an owner issue. Every baseline application name must match one declarations[].appPattern.
